_README: A recorded snapshot of `an.ir.camera.CAMERA_MOVES` — the closed set of camera moves `an` implements. muvid does NOT depend on `an` (soft import, no extra, none installed in CI), so without this file the only guard against muvid/renderers/animation.AN_CAMERA_MOVE_PHRASES drifting out of `an`'s vocabulary skips on every CI run — which is muvid#44's exact failure class, un-guarded. Same pattern as reelee-web's schemas/destructive-tools.json. Refresh with: python -c "import tests.test_animation_camera as t; t._refresh_snapshot()" (never hand-edit). Since muvid#277 it also records the entity kinds `an` registers once its genres are loaded (`an.genres.registry.entity_kind_names()` after `an.genres.load()`), the other vocabulary the synthesized scene.md names.
min_an_version_note: pan_left/pan_right/tilt_up/tilt_down arrived with an#109 (commit 061a155f, pyproject 0.1.64 at that commit, released as 0.1.65). At 0.1.64 and below `an` refuses them at validate and at compile.
